basis: Cleft palate and loose skin define oral and cutaneous involvement; dysmorphism alone does not establish another axis.
Rickettsial endothelial infection causes small-vessel vasculitis; transient rash does not establish additional skin damage.
Severe neurodevelopmental impairment, congenital cardiac defects and skeletal malformations are principal features in the definition.
Ovarian epithelial malignancy affects a reproductive organ; endocrine dysfunction is not part of its definition.
Benign cutaneous or subcutaneous tumour arising from sequestered epidermal derivatives.
Vesicoureteral reflux directly affects the urinary tract; unspecified skeletal findings lack evidence of common involvement.
In situ carcinoma originates in the nasopharynx, included in the airway axis; viral association alone does not establish active infection.
Neurodegeneration and optic atrophy define this mitochondrial metabolic disorder; organic aciduria 2/2 supports metabolism; cardiomyopathy 3/3. Hepatic glycogen alone lacks injury.
Chlamydia psittaci infection characteristically causes pneumonia; no other common direct organ damage is established.
Malignancy originates in rectal smooth muscle; its gastrointestinal location determines the axis.
Inherited organic acid metabolism disorder; neurodevelopmental injury affects roughly 30–70% and chronic kidney injury about 40–60%, varying by subtype and age.
Inherited peripheral nerve disease; secondary weakness or denervation does not establish a separate primary muscle disorder.
Inherited susceptibility is defined by the uveal tumour site; no established tumour or additional organ damage is inferred.
Abacavir toxicity typically denotes drug hypersensitivity; transient skin, gastrointestinal and respiratory symptoms do not establish lasting organ damage.
Destructive intracerebral cavities define the disease; associated seizures, spasticity and intellectual disability remain neurologic.
Adenocarcinoma originates in the urinary bladder, which belongs to the renal axis.
Pharyngeal cancer is the only supplied subtype and supports the airway axis; the broad neck designation leaves the actual organ of origin uncertain.
Localized benign epidermal melanocytic proliferation defines a skin lesion; no systemic involvement is established.
Nonsyndromic inherited sensorineural hearing loss directly affects hearing without established extra-aural involvement.
Cerebrovascular disease and resulting ischemic brain injury define the dementia; brain blood vessels are an explicit anatomical location.
Poikiloderma, cataracts and skeletal dysplasia define phenotype; low growth hormone 6/6 and hypothyroidism 5/6 support endocrine damage. Developmental/brain abnormalities 2/7 fall below 30%.
Ureteral triplication and extensive congenital skeletal malformations characterize the syndrome; cardiac and brain findings lack frequency evidence. Amastia has no axis.
Paraneoplastic immune-mediated inflammation directly targets the brainstem; the associated cancer is a separate disease.
Localized cutaneous mucinosis defines disease; systemic manifestations are heterogeneous without ≥30% evidence. Associated IgA nephropathy and gammopathy are separate diagnoses.
Allergic inflammation directly affects skin; ingestion as the trigger does not establish gastrointestinal injury.
